title: Mal’akha (angel)

paragraphs: In [Menachot 41a](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.41a.12), an angel found Rav Katina. [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Menachot.41a.12.1) explains that this was an angel.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara has an angel address Rav Katina about ritual fringes. Rashi likewise calls the figure an angel. The Aramaic is מלאכא.
